description: This file defines the main application component for a React single-page application (SPA). It sets up routing, including protected routes that require authentication, and includes components like login, forgot password, and a header. It also defines an internal Dashboard component used in protected routes.

methods.name: Dashboard
methods.description: A simple functional component that renders a welcome message for the dashboard area.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that provides routing and authentication context to the SPA.
